edits.name: isleA
edits.prompt: Repaint the first image as one small marsh island of reeds and wet mud standing in a river, in exactly the hand-painted storybook style of the riverbank pieces in the second image: soft painterly gouache shading, fine thin dark-brown linework, a mossy green grass top, warm brown layered soil. The island's top is one long, perfectly flat and level grassy walking surface from end to end, open and clear in the middle; clumps of cattail reeds and bulrushes grow only at the two ends, standing behind the top edge. Its sides are rounded, sloping banks of wet mud with a few small roots, darker and glistening wet toward the bottom, fading softly away at the very bottom. Keep its width, its flat top and the places of the two reed clumps. Keep the flat plain grey background around it, with empty grey space on every side.
